subject: inorganic
question:
无机化学·配位化学：请判断下列配合物的几何构型：Dioxotetrapyridinerhenium(V)（trans-[ReO₂(py)₄]⁺）？
A. Octahedral
B. Trigonal prismatic
C. Trigonal planar
D. Tetrahedral
explanation: Octahedral. Covalent count: Re (group 7) 7 e; 2 × O (X₂) 4 e; 4 × py (L) 8 e; the 1+ charge removes 1 e: 18 e. Ionic count: the ligands carry a charge of −4 in all and the complex has a 1+ charge, so the metal is Re(V), d²; d² + 16 e from the ligands = 18 e.
